decisions.reason: Existing authorized adapter and work-tool validation may proceed within their recorded scope; checks do not establish semantic correctness or product-wide efficacy.
Technical lessons may be technically reviewed and their existing authorized scope respected; this does not grant new sharing permission.
Publishing private role memory outside its authorized scope changes permission and is not authorized by existing technical work.

remaining: Run a bounded, recorded verification of memory retrieval/use on a pre-specified new task, retaining a comparison and checking scope and revocation behavior; do not claim benefit from retrieval alone.
Measure human review time and total task cost in a controlled comparison before claiming time savings or efficiency.
Test expertise discovery and routing against alternatives, including incorrect recommendations, stale knowledge, conflicts, and revoked access; proposal status is not implementation evidence.
Keep any private role memory within its existing authorization unless a human explicitly decides otherwise.
